title: Zucchini Boats
description: Hollowed zucchini filled with browned sausage, tomato, onion and the chopped zucchini insides, topped with Parmesan, mozzarella, breadcrumbs and parsley and baked.

ingredients.note: halved lengthwise, insides scooped out and chopped

steps.heading: Brown the Sausage
steps.text: Heat the oil in a pan and brown the sausage.

steps.heading: Build the Filling
steps.text: Add the garlic, tomato, chopped zucchini insides and onion, and season with salt and pepper.

steps.heading: Mix the Topping
steps.text: In a mixing bowl, combine the cheeses, parsley and breadcrumbs.

steps.heading: Fill & Bake
steps.text: Set the zucchini halves in a baking dish, fill them with the meat mixture, and cover with the topping. Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.
